text:
maria: Started offline replay with prefetch policy 'token_slab_v2' + token_budget_target=32. Quick summary: avg latency up 8% on 8k seqs, throughput down 6%, KV hit-rate -12pts. Putting logs below, need help diagnosing kernel selection vs batching.

anh: Can you paste the run config? which kernel selector was active?

maria: ```json
{
  "policy": "token_slab_v2",
  "token_budget_target": 32,
  "queue_policy": "age_weighted",
  "kernel_selector": "auto_r3_candidate",
  "kv_prefetch": true
}
```

tom: auto_r3_candidate flips to r3 for >1024 tokens; we saw that earlier. Any per-kernel breakdown?

perf-bot: per-kernel tokens/sec: r2=12500, r3=9800, fallback_cpu=4000; r3 has ~20% slower tail on 8k traces.

rachel: KV hit-rate drop looks suspicious — maybe prefetching evicts hot prefix entries? token_slab batches longer prefixes causing cache churn.

anil: Try token_budget_target=48 and reduce slab_size to 64. Also run A/B with: A=token_slab_v2+auto_r3, B=age_weighted+force_r2.

sree: I'll kick off A/B harness now with trace set 'prod-q1' and note eval metrics: latency_p95, qps, kv_hit. Tagging @maria :thumbsup:

perf-bot: AB_RUN 1855004321-ab1 started on trace prod-q1. CI ID: ab-88. Expected ~12h.

maria: Thanks. Also added a quick profiler snapshot; large kernel switch occurs around 23:40 in the trace (attached).

anh: If A/B shows r2 wins on latency but costs >10% more, need to weigh cost vs latency. Can we simulate cost-weighted reward?

tom: Yeah add metric 'tokens_per_sec_per_cost_unit' to harness.

maria: Adding it. Will post results tomorrow. For now pinning rollout to legacy r2 for dedicated.
